title: Work Queue — utility-column menus and column width limits (19 Oct 2026)
env: staging-crm.taviportal.com · tenant NDC-Staging · Edge 1600×900 · account ndc-staging-owner (CRM Admin)

panels.caption: My Leads → ≡ on the Add Note column: the only option is "Hide column", and it does nothing (the column stays, also after reload).
Tasks → ≡ on the Mark as completed column: same no-op "Hide column" (also on Row actions).
Every column dragged to its minimum (105 px, Clip Text): values cut to "QA RT …", "01000…", "ndc-st…"; the ≡ icon overlaps header labels; dates still take 2 lines.
Full Name dragged to the right: no maximum — 2708 px, then 5204 px on a second drag; all other columns pushed off-screen.
